verdict.rationale: Forter is a fraud-prevention and chargeback SaaS/API that receives order data and returns decisions. Acting as an MCP client that hosts third-party MCP servers falls outside its product role. The only MCP evidence (docs-9, docs-20, probe-2) describes Forter's own MCP server being connected to clients like Claude Desktop, which is the server role and is not credited for this client-side story.
